title: Easy Fried Crab Cakes
description: Easy fried crab cakes come together even faster with kids in the kitchen; they'll enjoy crushing the saltine crackers in a zip-top bag with a rolling pin.
ingredients: 2 stalks green onions, white parts only, minced
3 tablespoons mayonnaise, or more to taste
1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, or more to taste
2 tablespoons seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
1 cup Italian-seasoned bread crumbs, or more as needed
2 tablespoons canola oil, or more as needed

steps.text: Mix crushed crackers, bell pepper, green onions, egg, mayonnaise, and Dijon together in a large bowl. Gently fold in crabmeat, seafood seasoning, and black pepper using a wooden spoon or spatula. Form crabmeat mixture into 1/2-inch-thick patties, 2 to 3 inches in diameter.
Put bread crumbs on a plate. Coat patties with bread crumbs.

Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add patties in batches and cook until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes on each side. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels. Repeat with remaining patties, adding more oil as needed.
